title: Green Dog and Dream Tree
description: A surreal desert scene at night featuring a large green dog with tree branches growing from its body. The dark branches are adorned with glowing orbs containing miniature scenes including a red cat, a person walking, and a crescent moon. A young man's face with closed eyes is embedded in the dog's fur, while a small red mouse sits near the roots in the sand.
prompt: Surreal nighttime desert landscape with rolling dunes under a starry sky. A giant lime-green dog stands in profile, its body transforming into a dark gnarled tree with intricate branches. The branches bear translucent glowing spheres containing miniature dream scenes: a red cat, a lone walker, and crescent moons. A peaceful young man's face with closed eyes and visible cracks is embedded in the dog's neck and shoulder. A small red mouse stands near the tree roots in the sand. Mystical and ethereal atmosphere.
